contact_state_predict — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.contact_state_predict(kp, tip_xyz, axis, tol: 'float' = 6e-05) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.contact_state_predict(kp, tip_xyz, axis, tol: 'float' = 6e-05) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("contact_state_predict"))

Usage

Predicts the number and location of contact points from the true peg pose (tip center and axis direction) by geometry alone (a 2nd implementation independent of the contact computation).

If the circle of the tip edge (radius r; horizontal projection is an ellipse with r along e₁ and r cos θ along the tilt) reaches the circle R of the hole's narrowest part (in the chamfer band, the cone radius at that height), it is "tip"; if the horizontal cross-section of the body at the narrowest part (z = −W) (ellipse with radii r and r/cos θ) reaches R, it is "mouth". Where the body touches the chamfer cone is always the edge of the narrowest part if tan θ < 1 (the cone radius increases by 1 per unit height, while the cross-section centre moves only by tan θ).

Returns: n (0/1/2), where ("none" / "chamfer" / "tip" / "mouth" / "tip+mouth"), depth (tip depth from the mouth plane; negative means in the air), depth_below_chamfer, tilt [rad]. tol is the radial margin for counting as "reached". Raises ValueError: axis is zero, tip_xyz shape is not (3,).
